alignments.note: `פֶּלֶס` rendered *balance* with its indefinite article under rule 15, discontinuous around the fronted attributive under rule 25.
Rectum of `מֹאזְנֵי מִשְׁפָּט` rendered attributively under rule 28; the ASV moves the attributive to the head of the whole coordination.

Possessive `לְ` rendered inside an English genitive; one word carries both the relation and the name, so the pair fuses under rule 49's closing paragraph, and the construction's copula joins that one unit.
Quantifying construct noun keeps only its own word under rule 19.
Construct noun with supplied *the* under rule 29.
Rectum takes *of* under rule 19 with its supplied *the*.
Nominal predicate of a verbless clause takes the construction-supplied copula under rule 20, discontinuous around the possessive under rule 25.
Suffix rendered by the possessive *his* under rule 18.

review_notes: `פֶּלֶס` is read as *balance* and `מֹאזְנֵי` as *scales*, which preserves the Hebrew order; the competing reading swaps them and makes both units discontinuous.
*are Jehovah's* is a fused `לְ` + name under rule 49's closing paragraph rather than a copula split onto the preposition.
